New KTM 1390 Super Duke GT Evo Debuts - AMT, 8.8-inch TFT, Offline Sat-Nav

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • KTM has unveiled the all-new 1390 Super Duke GT Evo at EICMA 2026, which is positioned above the standard 1390 Super Duke GT.
  • The new model gets a range of exclusive features, while borrowing the 1,350 cc LC8 V-twin engine platform from the KTM 1390 Super Adventure S Evo.
  • Official reporting verified via Rushlane.com news desk.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

KTM has unveiled the all-new 1390 Super Duke GT Evo at EICMA 2026, which is positioned above the standard 1390 Super Duke GT. The new model gets a range of exclusive features, while borrowing the 1,350 cc LC8 V-twin engine platform from the KTM 1390 Super Adventure S Evo. KTM 1390 Super Duke GT Evo will go on sale across global markets in early 2027. Whether it will make its way to India remains to be seen.

📌 The Core Development

Engineered for sport-touring, KTM 1390 Super Duke GT Evo gets an advanced AMT transmission. What’s even better is that users have the option to choose between fully automated operation or manual shifting. The latter may be preferred by experienced riders or in specific scenarios where more responsive feedback and greater manual control are needed.

With the AMT active, users don’t need to shift gears, making long distance sport-touring a lot less tiring. KTM 1390 Super Duke GT Evo uses a 1,350cc, 2-cylinder, V 75° engine, which is the same as in use with 1390 Super Adventure S Evo. It generates 187 hp and 145 Nm of peak torque.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

KTM has introduced new features with the 1390 Super Duke GT Evo to enhance rider comfort and safety. For context, a more upright riding stance is possible with the forward-adjustable handlebars. Similarly, the windshield can be adjusted to low and high positions, as per requirement. The bike has a seat height of 834 mm. It weighs 213 kg and has 149 mm of ground clearance.

Latest-gen electronically-controlled WP Semi Active Technology (SAT) suspension has been used, with easy adjustability options via the dashboard. This suspension setup uses a new patented thru-rod construction, making it lighter than previous-gen versions. Riders benefit from a more precise and consistent response. Users can also adjust the hydraulic clutch and brake levers.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

Frame stiffness has been improved and is now 3X higher than the standard model. Precision handling and front tyre feedback have been improved with more robust connections between the frame, forks, triple clamps and swingarm. The bike has enhanced stability and offers an optimized balance between comfort and sporty riding.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

KTM 1390 Super Duke GT Evo has 17-inch wheels at both ends, wrapped in Michelin Power 6 tires. These are 120/70 at the front and 190/55 at the rear. The overall setup is 1.2 kg lighter and the tyres have special compounds that enhance straight line control and cornering grip. Braking setup comprises four-piston Brembo Stylema monoblock callipers with 320 mm floating discs at the front and a twin-piston floating calliper with a 240 mm disc at the rear.

KTM 1390 Super Duke GT Evo gets an 8.8-inch TFT display with an easy menu structure. It has full offline onboard map navigation and a USB Type-C charging port. The bike uses a new LED headlight setup, which has better near field illumination and a larger field of view up to 90 degrees.
